title: LandlordGuard Late Fee Household Credit for Multi-Policy Members
content:
**Terms.** The household credit on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy late fee rewards a named insured who keeps other protection with Larkspur Mutual: a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force together with a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy in force takes 3.00 USD off; exactly one of the two takes 1.50 USD off; neither takes nothing off.

The household credit is taken off in the late-fee adjustment.

| HomeGuard Homeowners Policy in force | Larkspur umbrella in force | Household credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 3.00 USD off |
| yes | no | 1.50 USD off |
| no | yes | 1.50 USD off |
| no | no | nothing |

## Records read

Each condition reads whether the named insured holds a policy of that product whose status is in force. A HomeGuard or umbrella policy that is cancelled, expired or not yet in force does not meet it.

## Hypothetical households

- A landlord with a HomeGuard policy in force on the family home and a Larkspur umbrella in force: 3.00 USD off.
- A landlord whose umbrella expired last month and who has no HomeGuard policy: nothing.
